title: Thai Almond Chicken Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic Thai dish made with chicken, almond, and pilaf, perfect for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on both sides and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the sliced almond and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, fish sauce, and molten syrup.
Pour the sauce over the chicken and almond mixture, and stir to coat.
Add the pilaf to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the pilaf is heated through.
Serve hot and garnish with quaintly, if desired.
Note: If using quaintly, add it to the skillet with the chicken and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
